description: Rank trading partners for a reporter by trade value for a given commodity and flow direction. Returns the top N partners sorted by descending value — answers "who does country X mainly export product Y to?" or "where does country X mainly import product Z from?" for a single period. Fetches a disaggregated breakdown across all partners then sorts locally. Omit cmd_code to rank partners for total trade.

cmd_code.description: Single HS commodity code (e.g. "84", "8471"). Omit or pass "TOTAL" to rank partners for total merchandise trade.

limit.description: Maximum number of top partners to return.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country.

name: comtrade_get_top_partners

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no data is returned.

partners.description: Top partners sorted by descending trade value.

items.description: A single ranked trading partner entry.

primaryValueUsd.description: Trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

sharePercent.description: Share of total trade value among returned partners, as a percentage.

totalPartners.description: Total partners with non-zero trade value returned by API.

totalValueUsd.description: Sum of primary values across all returned partners (before limit truncation).

truncated.description: True when API returned 500 records and results may be incomplete.

title: Get Top Trading Partners
